primaryNotice: Two bases: Kotor (Oct 1, 4, 5) and Žabljak (Oct 2, 3). The adjusted daily driving ceiling is 5.5 hours, including a +20% mountain-terrain allowance. P14 over Sedlo is the featured Day 3 out-and-back; conservative planning is about 5.4 adjusted hours with only the Plužine/Piva viewpoint stop. Public estimates vary, so confirm the complete live route with waypoints before departure and trim any extra stop if it exceeds 5.5 hours. Finish high-altitude driving by 16:00. Skip P14 for snow, ice, poor visibility, a closure, or unsafe road conditions. Tara Bridge is closed through Oct 26, 2026 at noon and is excluded.
fallbackNotice: Use this branch if P14/Sedlo or the northern transfer is unsafe, closed, or over the 5.5-hour adjusted daily ceiling. Kotor remains the base for all five nights; Days 3–5 cover Lovćen/Cetinje, Lake Skadar, and the Bay. No high alpine roads are used.

days.drive: TIV → Kamenari–Lepetane ferry → Kotor · allow 45–75 min including queue; direct road alternative
days.afternoon: 15:15–15:30 effective road start after baggage and rental desk. Optional Kamenari–Lepetane car ferry (published Oct off-season passenger-car fare €4; recheck service/queue); take the direct road if the queue is long. Go straight to Kotor lodging, check in and unload all four bags before any viewpoint, swim or Old Town visit.
days.evening: After check-in, choose an easy Old Town dinner and waterfront walk; if arrival or traffic runs late, stay near the hotel.
days.parking: Use the hotel’s guarded lot or marked Kotor parking after check-in. Never leave bags in the car.
days.cash: Have €4 ferry fare available; carry €20–30 in small notes for tips and small purchases.

days.drive: Kotor → Nikšić → Šavnik → Žabljak · cited 3 h 04, about 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: 07:00 depart Kotor after breakfast. Check AMSCG road notices, weather and live routing; the cited route is about 3 h 41 after +20%, within the 5.5-hour adjusted ceiling. Allow breaks and finish the transfer in daylight; do not use the closed Tara Bridge corridor.
days.afternoon: Go directly to booked Žabljak lodging. Confirm early check-in or guarded luggage storage in advance, unload and secure every bag, then take only a short Black Lake shore visit if time and weather permit; leave the park area by 16:00.
days.evening: Guesthouse dinner in Žabljak; confirm heating, dinner service and guarded parking when booking.
days.parking: Go directly to booked lodging; unload and check in before any park walk. No luggage in a parked car.
days.cash: Carry €10/person for Durmitor day entry (or compare with the €13.50/person 2026 annual pass); keep small notes for rural purchases.

days.drive: Žabljak → P14/Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine/Piva viewpoint → return · plan 4 h 30 wheel time / 5 h 24 adjusted; LIVE ROUTE GATE REQUIRED
days.morning: 07:15 check AMSCG, local lodging host and current forecast for the P14/Sedlo pass; check the complete Žabljak–Trsa–Plužine–Piva viewpoint–Žabljak route in Maps with waypoints. Depart by 07:45 only if roads are open, dry enough, visibility is good, and the estimated full driving time including the +20% terrain uplift is ≤5.5 h. Skip the route for snow, ice, poor visibility or unsafe conditions.
days.afternoon: Drive the P14 over Sedlo (about 1,911 m), pausing only at safe signed pullouts and the Piva viewpoint/lakeside near Plužine. This is an out-and-back, not a through-route. Return to Žabljak and finish all high-altitude driving by 16:00. Do not add Mratinje Dam or a cheese-farm detour unless live waypoint routing still totals ≤5.5 adjusted hours and preserves the 16:00 return. If it does not, remove detours; if the core out-and-back still exceeds the ceiling, do not call it compliant and use the fallback branch.
days.evening: Early alpine dinner in Žabljak; keep the remainder close to lodging.
days.parking: Start and finish at Žabljak lodging with bags secured there. Use only signed pullouts; never stop on narrow blind bends. Carry offline Maps.me trail/road data and do not rely on cell coverage.
days.cash: Carry €10/person for Durmitor entry if charged on the chosen route, plus small notes for village food. Do not budget the old traveler-reported boat/rafting prices; Tara rafting is excluded while bridge access is closed.
stops: Optional Mratinje Dam — only if route gate passes

days.drive: Žabljak → Šavnik → Nikšić → Kotor · route estimates vary; 3 h 04 cited, 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: Depart Žabljak by 07:00 in daylight. Check same-day road, weather and visibility reports. The cited 3 h 04 route is about 3 h 41 with +20%, within the 5.5 h adjusted ceiling; do not route across the closed Đurđevića Tara Bridge.
days.afternoon: Drive directly to Kotor. Confirm luggage storage/early check-in, then unload and secure all bags before any visit. Stop safely and contact lodging/rental support if weather deteriorates.
days.evening: Kotor Old Town dinner and a gentle waterfront evening.
days.parking: Book Kotor lodging with guarded parking; unload immediately on arrival. Do not detour with luggage exposed.
days.cash: Keep €20 for fuel/toll contingencies; this route does not require Sozina or the A1.

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · about 1 h 12 each way; 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: 08:00 depart for Virpazar with hotel luggage secured in Kotor. The official Skadar park listing says the €5/person daily ticket includes one cruise; confirm October boat departures, weather, exact inclusion and payment with the operator before relying on it. Be ashore by 15:45. Historical traveler reports of €10 group and €50 private rides are not current quotes.
days.afternoon: Lakeside lunch, then a reserved Godinje tasting (driver abstains); return to Kotor before dusk. Choose one alternate instead of the lake: Perast waterfront/Our Lady of the Rocks boat, or Budva Old Town with a Sveti Stefan/Miločer viewpoint/beach visit. Keep Kotor as the base, check October boat/beach operations and traffic/parking, and do not combine full outings.
days.evening: Last full evening in Kotor: local seafood or Njeguši cheese and prosciutto, then waterfront dinner/walk.
days.parking: Use signed Virpazar parking at the village edge; boat pier is walkable. Bags remain at the Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €20–40/person in small notes for park/boat or coastal parking and village purchases; quoted traveler fares are historical. Two day entries at €5 each cost €10/person; the 2026 all-parks annual pass is €13.50/person and only beats three or more separate park-days.
stops: Our Lady of the Rocks pier — optional alternate

days.drive: Kotor → TIV · about 10–15 min; airport 7.7 km
days.morning: 08:30 breakfast in Kotor. Leave by 09:30, refuel if required by the rental agreement, return the car by 11:30 and reach TIV terminal no later than 12:15 for mandatory physical counter check-in before the 14:55 flight.
days.afternoon: Flight departure 14:55. Keep rental paperwork and travel documents accessible.
days.parking: No sightseeing detours. Allow 30–45 minutes for car inspection and terminal transfer; follow rental provider’s return instructions.
days.cash: Keep a payment card and deposit paperwork accessible.

checks.name: Mandatory Durmitor / northern highlands
checks.detail: Day 3 traverses P14/Sedlo and reaches Plužine/Piva; Tara Bridge and rafting are excluded.

checks.name: Two-base star-trip lodging
checks.detail: Kotor nights 1, 4 and 5; Žabljak nights 2 and 3. Two hotel changes.

checks.name: Daily adjusted driving ≤5.5 h
checks.detail: Transfer days are about 3 h 41 adjusted from cited 3 h 04 route times. P14 is provisionally budgeted at 5 h 24 adjusted (4 h 30 wheel time), but route estimates vary. Check all waypoints on the day; remove optional spurs first. If the core P14 loop exceeds 5.5 h, it fails and must not be labelled compliant.

checks.name: P14 daylight and weather gate
checks.detail: Start by 07:45 only after same-day road and weather checks; return to Žabljak and finish high-altitude driving by 16:00. Skip for snow, ice, poor visibility, closure or unsafe conditions.

checks.name: Luggage concealment
checks.detail: Day 1 ferry/road goes directly to Kotor lodging; Day 2 goes directly to Žabljak lodging. Check in or confirm guarded luggage storage before excursions; no bags remain exposed in a parked vehicle.

checks.name: Day 6 airport radius and terminal by 12:15
checks.detail: Kotor–TIV is within 30 minutes under normal traffic; car return by 11:30, terminal by 12:15.

checks.name: Tara bridge closure avoided
checks.detail: Official closure extends through Oct 26, 2026 at noon; neither branch depends on crossing it. Rafting is omitted unless an operator confirms safe independent access.

days.afternoon: 15:15–15:30 road start. Test-load all four bags below the parcel cover, drive straight to Kotor and check in/unload.
days.evening: Easy Old Town dinner and waterfront walk.
days.parking: Guarded hotel lot or marked Kotor parking after unloading.

days.drive: Local Kotor / Perast · allow ≤2 h total
days.morning: Kotor Old Town and Maritime Museum lanes; start the city walls early, subject to the municipality’s October hours and current ticket confirmation.
days.afternoon: Perast waterfront and Our Lady of the Rocks boat only if the skipper confirms October service and sea state. Return to Kotor by 16:00.
days.evening: Dinner in Kotor; book a table in advance for a quiet waterfront setting.
days.parking: Hotel parking or marked public lots; use signed Perast parking, not the narrow waterfront road.
days.cash: Carry €15–25/person in small notes for park and optional boat; historic €10 group / €50 private traveler prices are not current quotes. Check whether the park ticket includes a cruise and confirm payment before boarding.
stops: Our Lady of the Rocks pier

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Lovćen ↔ Cetinje · plan 2.5 h adjusted
days.morning: 08:00 leave Kotor for Lovćen via the serpentine. Drive in daylight, use signed viewpoints and check fog/wet-road conditions before climbing.
days.afternoon: Short Ivanova Korita marked walk; continue to Cetinje historic center and return to Kotor before 16:00. Do not add P14 or other high alpine routes.
days.evening: Montenegrin dinner: ask for kačamak, Njeguši cheese or prosciutto; return to Kotor lodging.
days.parking: Use signed Lovćen visitor parking; park at marked Cetinje public lot. Leave all luggage at Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €20/person for park entry, parking and rural cafés; verify entrance charge locally.

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: 08:00 depart for Virpazar. Take a pre-booked 10:00–12:00 boat only after confirming October operations, lake weather, return time and payment method.
days.afternoon: Lakeside lunch and optional Winery Garnet/Godinje tasting by reservation. Driver abstains. Return to Kotor before dusk; if boat service is cancelled, use the village/winery alternative.
days.evening: Dinner in Kotor; keep the evening relaxed after the lake day.
days.parking: Park in signed Virpazar parking; bags stay secured at Kotor hotel.
days.cash: Carry €20–40/person in small notes. Historic traveler boat fares are not current quotes; confirm October operations, what the €5/person ticket includes and cash/card acceptance before booking.

days.morning: Slow breakfast, then drive to Tivat for pre-booked Regent Porto Montenegro spa access/treatment. Nonresident day access and price must be confirmed directly.
days.afternoon: Return to Kotor by 15:30; alternative is a coastal promenade and a second short Old Town visit. Keep luggage at the hotel.
days.evening: Farewell waterfront dinner in Kotor, with a reserved table and sunset walk.
days.parking: Use hotel parking in Kotor and the spa/Porto Montenegro marked or valet parking in Tivat. No bags in the car.
days.cash: Allow €100–180/person if spa access is confirmed; confirm rates and payment method.

days.morning: 08:30 breakfast. Depart 09:30, refuel if required, return car by 11:30 and reach terminal by 12:15 for 14:55 departure.
days.parking: No detours; allow 30–45 min for rental inspection and terminal transfer.
days.cash: Keep card and rental paperwork accessible.

checks.name: Alpine weather fallback avoids high alpine roads
checks.detail: All nights remain in Kotor; Days 3–5 visit central and coastal sites only.

checks.name: One-base star-trip lodging
checks.detail: Kotor for all five nights; no hotel moves after airport arrival.

checks.name: Daily adjusted driving ≤5.5 h
checks.detail: Planned maximum is 2 h 53 including the +20% terrain allowance. Check route conditions and actual waypoint times daily.

checks.name: Mountain / boat daylight margin
checks.detail: Lovćen and boat activities are scheduled to finish by 16:00; confirm weather, service and civil twilight on the day.

checks.name: Luggage concealment
checks.detail: All bags are unloaded and secured at the Kotor lodging on Day 1; no transfer days.

checks.name: Day 6 airport radius and terminal by 12:15
checks.detail: Kotor is about 10–15 minutes from TIV; car return by 11:30.

checks.name: Tara bridge access
checks.detail: Fallback does not route near the bridge or alpine approaches.

budget.label: Lodging · 5 nights, two adults
budget.note: Planning range for guarded parking at Kotor x3 nights + Žabljak x2 (primary); fallback is Kotor x5. Not live inventory.

budget.label: Rental · estate/wagon + insurance
budget.note: Five-day planning allowance. Exact midsize estate, low-excess SCDW, glass, tires/wheels, underbody/gravel and roadside cover must be quoted.

budget.label: Fuel + tolls
budget.note: Planning range includes the extra P14 out-and-back mileage and mountain elevation gains. Ferry is €4 each way for a small passenger car in Oct (off-season); routes do not require Sozina or the A1. Fuel rates and ferry tariffs should be rechecked shortly before travel.

budget.label: Parks + boat + walls + spa
budget.note: Planning allowance for two-person park admissions, confirmed Skadar boat only if not included in the park ticket, Kotor walls and optional spa. Durmitor and Skadar day entries list €5/person; Skadar listing says one cruise is included. The 2026 all-parks pass is €13.50/person and is not worthwhile for only two park-days. Confirm October operations and ticket terms.

budget.label: Food & drink
budget.note: €90–150 per couple per day, including one winery/local tasting allowance.

budget.label: Contingency cash
budget.note: Carry €100–150 in small cash notes; reserve total also covers weather reroutes, fuel and unplanned fees.

curatedPool.note: Reserve directly; menu and October opening hours vary by venue.
